                try:
                    tz = ZoneInfo(tz)

content = content.replace(old_get_str, new_get_str, 1)

# Change 2: get() default UTC for timestamps (line 233)

    "                    # set to UTC by default\n                    tz = dateutil_tz.tzutc()",
    "                    # set to UTC by default\n                    tz = dt_timezone.utc",
    1
)

# Change 3: now() local tz and string tz (lines 340-343)

            tz = dateutil_tz.tzlocal()

            tz = datetime.now().astimezone().tzinfo
        elif isinstance(tz, str):
            try:
                tz = ZoneInfo(tz)
            except Exception:
                tz = parser.TzinfoParser.parse(tz)"""
